guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (Two-Tone Sunburst signature) / PRS Silver Sky
guitar.notes: Confirmed — John Mayer has had a long-documented signature relationship with Fender Stratocasters and more recently PRS Silver Sky.

tone.target: warm clean acoustic-like steel-string sparkle with light compression
tone.profile: warm clean acoustic-like steel-string sparkle with light compression
tone.summary: A highly articulate and warm clean signal chain using light compression, a classic Fender-style amp (US Deluxe), and subtle room reverb to emulate acoustic sparkle while maintaining electric clarity.
corrections: Remove chorus; it should sound mostly dry.
